final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. It is owned by security@harborlight.example and valid until 2027-11-17. Access Control Policy section 4.3 backs it up: access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day. There's no live check for offboarding, so this is what the policy says, not a check of current practice.

policy:bcd55f51-0107-4af3-a3ef-9809ad362: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:76cc4e9e-a02c-4323-ae6e-8cb84d069: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
policy:9d4268cb-9570-4035-8058-acd8f0911: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:8f0caead-f469-4ffa-a4d4-7d24e30e2: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:8ae6b61c-cdc4-4313-bba8-58b91adaa: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
